methodologyNotes: Covers cast-iron, steel competition, and adjustable kettlebells sold to consumers at a published US price. Excludes soft/sand-filled kettlebells, kettlebell handles sold without weight, and gym-only bulk pallets. Price is typical US MSRP in USD for a single representative weight (16 kg / 35 lb where a line offers fixed weights; the full adjustable unit where applicable); priceNote states which. weightRangeLb is the span of weights the product line offers, in pounds (single value if only one weight is sold). material is an enum: cast-iron, steel-competition, or adjustable. coating is an enum describing the finish: powder-coat, e-coat, gravity-cast-raw, matte-black, vinyl, or chrome-handle. handleDiameterMm is the grip (handle bar) thickness in millimeters at its thinnest gripped point. adjustable is a boolean (true if a single bell changes weight via plates or a dial). weightIncrementLb is the smallest weight-change step in pounds for adjustable models; null for fixed-weight bells. competitionStandard is a boolean, true only if the bell uses the sport-standard uniform 35 mm handle and constant ~33 cm hollow body across all weights. flatBase is a boolean, true if the bottom is machined flat enough for renegade rows / handstands. singleCastConstruction is a boolean, true if the body and handle are one continuous cast/forged piece with no welded handle seam. warrantyYears is the manufacturer warranty length in years; use 100 to denote a stated lifetime/limited-lifetime warranty; null if undisclosed.

products.name: REP Fitness Kettlebell
products.priceNote: REP Fitness official "Kettlebells (kg)" product page lists the 16 kg individual bell at $74.99 (shown as pre-order at time of access). Per the catalog methodology, 16 kg is the representative fixed weight used for pricing.
products.provenance: The REP Fitness official "Kettlebells (kg)" page confirms model identity as REP's single cast-iron kettlebell line (gravity die-cast, iron-cast, "perfectly flat base," "textured, premium black coating," handles color-coded to international standards) spanning 4kg/9lbs to 48kg/106lbs, and lists the 16 kg bell at $74.99. The BarBend review (updated Nov 2024) corroborates this as REP's "main bell model" — a single-cast gravity-cast iron bell with a matte-black textured finish and flat bottom — and measures the 24 kg unit's handle at 39mm, matching REP's per-color table ("GREEN - 39MM"); REP lists the yellow (16 kg, international standard) bell at "YELLOW - 33MM Handle," the value reported here to stay consistent with the 16 kg representative weight. Handle diameter varies 30–40mm across weights so competitionStandard is false, and a kettlebell-specific warranty length is not disclosed so warrantyYears is null.

products.name: Rogue E-Coat Kettlebell
products.priceNote: US price for the representative 35 LB / 16 kg bell: $85.00, listed verbatim as "KB-35LB Rogue Kettlebell - E Coat $85.00" on the Rogue Fitness product page. Fixed-weight line ranges from $48.00 (KB-9LB) to $173.00 (KB-88LB).
products.provenance: The Rogue Fitness product page (source) confirmed this exact model — "Rogue Kettlebell - E Coat," ductile cast iron, black E-Coat semi-gloss finish, single-piece cast with a flat machined base — and listed the representative 35 LB / 16 kg bell at $85.00 (line spans $48.00–$173.00 across 9 LB to 88 LB). The garagegymproducts.com review (corroboration, dated June 8, 2023) independently confirms the same model: ductile iron, E-Coat finish, US-made, a 9–88 lb range, matching handle diameters (1.2"/1.4"/1.5"), and single-piece shipping. Handle diameter is stated only in inches (1.5" for the 35 LB bell) on both pages, so handleDiameterMm is left null rather than converted to a non-verbatim mm figure; warranty length and release date are not stated, so both are null.

products.name: Bells of Steel Competition Kettlebell
products.priceNote: US MSRP for the representative 16 kg bell = $138.99 USD, listed verbatim as "16 KG $138.99 USD" on the Bells of Steel US store page (bellsofsteel.us). The fixed-weight line ranges from $57.99 USD (4 kg) to $545.99 USD (48 kg) on the same page.
products.provenance: The manufacturer's US store page (bellsofsteel.us) confirmed this exact line — Competition Kettlebells sold in fixed weights from 4 kg to 48 kg — listing the 16 kg representative bell at $138.99 USD, with a spec table stating Cast Iron material, Powder Coat coating, a 35 mm handle (34 mm on the 4/6/8 kg bells), "cast as one piece with no welds," and a Limited Lifetime warranty. The BarBend review (last updated July 22, 2024) corroborated the same model: it gives the pound weight range of nine to 106 pounds across 16 weights, the competition-standard 35 mm handle on all but the two lightest bells (9 and 13 lb use 34 mm), the wide flat base, and solid one-piece casting that eliminates welding — while also noting the heaviest four (80–106 lb) have solid cores, so the line is NOT uniform across all weights (hence competitionStandard=false). Model identity is confirmed by matching product name, weight ladder, hollow-core construction, GSU/IKFF/IUKL standards, and handle/window dimensions across both pages; note the manufacturer labels the material "Cast Iron" while BarBend calls it "Alloy steel," and it is classified here under the catalog's competition-kettlebell type enum (steel-competition).

products.name: Titan Fitness Cast Iron Kettlebell
products.priceNote: US price for the representative 35 lb fixed weight (per methodology's 35 lb representative rule). Manufacturer titan.fitness lists the 35 LB Cast Iron Kettlebell at "Regular price $79.99"; Walmart corroborates "Current price is USD $79.99".
products.provenance: Fetched the official Titan Fitness product page for the 35 LB Cast Iron Kettlebell (the representative 35 lb fixed weight per methodology), whose Specifications table verbatim states Material: Cast-Iron, Finish: Powder-Coated Black, Handle Diameter: 38 mm, Product Weight 35 lb., a "Drop Cast Iron" / "One-piece design", a "Flat base for easy storage and exercise such as handstands", and "1-Year warranty included" at a "Regular price $79.99"; the overview states the line ranges "from 5 LB to 100 LB". Both pages confirm this is the cast-iron line (not the separate competition or adjustable kettlebell lines).
